Hungary Hungary Hungary a kamu "Magyarorsza'g" han u i Cung-ow Pannonia masaenal ku lalabu nu kanatal, 93030 kungli kaahebal, nuwaminsa a belaw u Slovakia, nuwalia amis a belaw u Ukraine, nuwalian atu nuwalian timul balaw u Romania, nutimulan a belaw u Serbia, satipan timul belaw Croatia, satipan belaw Slovenia, satipan nuwamisan a belaw u Austria. kanatal a kamu Magyarok han, nu Ouzhou ku kamu. caay ku nu Yindu Ouzhou a kamu. u Oumeng tatudungay a ahebal nu kanatal. kahenunal a tu-se atu satabakiay a tu-se u Budapest, nu zumaay a tabakiay tu-se zuma satu u Debrecen, Szeged, Miskolc, Bei-chi, Jiaoer. ayzaay a Hungary a kanatal i ayaw tu malebut a mihcaan namakuwan nu pinaay a binacadan, pasu Dacia a tademaw, Celtic (Kai-er-te a tademaw 凱爾特人), Roman (Romae 羅馬) a tademaw, Germanic (Rierman a mihcaan hawsa, sawaliayan u pahabayay tu aadupan a binacadan Magyar a tademaw namakay Ula-san-silu atu Voga-River a sauwacan, nu yazaay a Basgort-tele, pasayza i satipan mabulaw, i 896 a mihcaan i patizegay a saan, ciniza i kasumamadan tu 9 a mihcaan tu sazikuzay a mihcaan mikelad tu Magyar a tademawan tayza i enal nu Pannonia.1000年, 1000 a mihcaan Hungary a Hungti ci Istvan Urbanyi cacay a lasubu a mihcaan i Hungary palekal tu kelistukiw mala ku-cyaw, satu pakala tu nu kiwkay a nipacakat mala u saayaway a Hungti nu Hungary , patizeng satu Hungary a Hungti a kanatal. kasumamadan u laylay malecad tu Bolan atu Bohemian makakayat tu, namahiza namapalilid nu ciwlu atu u kasenengan a Roman Empire a Hungti. 1241 a mihcaan katukuh i 1242 a mihcaan, ci Ba-du satipan micumud mingawaw, Hungary namapihaceng ku nikapeci'. satu Hungary haymaw satu macakat mala nu Europe u saicelangay misatekeday hungti a kanatal. izaw ku salungayay masacidekay a lalangawan, mahiza u nu Xiou nuzuma a macakata a nikauzip macacayat tu. Hunyadi Matyas i 1458 a mihcaan katukuh 1490 a mihcaan mikuwan tu Hungar talaayaw satu ciniza pasaicelang tu Hungary atu cin-bu a icelang. i pikuwan niza hawsa, Hungary " uyzaan saca u nuwamisanay, ayzaay a Slovakia nu zumaay a kakitizaan" mala u palekalan tu lalangawan nalimaan a mihcaan, Ouzhou a kasaupuan kapulungay tu nalimaan lalangawan. cin-經濟 uyniay a kanatal caay kadadah ku nu tahakay a laculan, u tapang u ku'ng-can u Lu-tu, pisuped a kayadah sakatul i Europe. mamin i kanatal 2/3 a kakitizaan izaw ku akutiay a lalaculan. u kalukan ku tapang a kahenulan. tapang nipalumaan izaw ku habay, kubkub, malinsu, atu sicedamay a lami'. u kung-ye u kikay ku misangaay, nu keciay a kikay, misabaluhay tu kakanan atu mitenunay ku tapang, misaepah tu badisusu' kya singangan.namakay 2004 a mihcaan lima a bulad cacay a demiad mala baluhay a tademaw nu Oumenng, Hungary a cin-ci lalid sa icelang macakat. imahini izaw ku nu uzipay a kusi patahkal paanina uynian a kanatal payhun 80% katalakaw tu GDP. 2007 a mihcaan hawsa, mahamin ku kitakitay malilid tu kapelpel nu cin-ci, Hungary kalamkam satu malawacu ku cinci. ducduc tu pulung nisulitan, Hungary i kitakit u sapihacengay kalihanawan a cinci nu kanatal. maydih a malaheci' tahkal i 2020 a mihcaan sibalucu' micumud tu Ouzhou a kalisiwan, uynian a kanatal maydih a talaayaw ku cin-ci pasumad.
